how_run: No Windows build exists, and a source build for Windows fails at start: it creates a temp directory named 'gitea.cnoe.localtest.me:28443' (':' is invalid on Windows). Ran the checksum-verified Linux release binary inside docker:latest with the host Docker socket and Docker Desktop's VM network, same laptop and Docker as Warden.
command: idpbuilder create --name e7 --port 28443 --no-exit=false -p hello   (hello = Argo CD Application + Deployment/Service of nginx-unprivileged:1.27-alpine, 2 replicas)
first_app_note: a pre-built public image deployed from a local package; no build, signing or registry push involved

warden_same_moment.note: four services, k6 load at 40 rps per service, monitoring

components: argocd (applicationset, dex, notifications, redis, repo-server, server, application-controller)
developer_portal: not in the core install (Backstage comes with the separate reference-implementation stacks)
fairness_note: idpbuilder is a reference starter platform, not a supply-chain product; this compares scope, not quality.
